abilities.name: Warp In Pylon
abilities.text:
Warp in a Pylon that generates a Power Field and grants vision of the surrounding area. Probius only regenerates mana while inside a Power Field. Enemy Heroes and Minions drop Minerals when killed. Gather Minerals to reduce the cooldown of Warp In Pylon by 0.75 seconds.

Up to 2 Pylons can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Disruption Pulse
abilities.text:
Fire a burst of energy forward, dealing 142 damage to all enemies it passes through.

Hitting the center of a Warp Rift will cause it to explode, dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: Warp Rift
abilities.text:
Open an unstable Warp Rift at a location that takes 1.25 seconds to arm, which then Slows nearby enemies by 25% lasting 3 seconds.

Armed Warp Rifts explode when they expire or when hit by Disruption Pulse, dealing 261 damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Photon Cannon
abilities.text:
Warp in a Photon Cannon that deals 105 damage. Lasts for 13 seconds.

While within a Pylon's Power Field, Photon Cannons gain 40% Attack Speed over 4 seconds and reveal nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pylon Overcharge
abilities.text: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

abilities.name: Null Gate
abilities.text:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

1.name: Echo Pulse
1.text: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

1.name: Warp Resonance
1.text:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions.

Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120.

Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

1.name: Gather Minerals
1.text:
Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560.

Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

4.name: Photon Barrier
4.text: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

4.name: Turbo Charged
4.text: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

4.name: Shield Capacitor
4.text: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

7.name: Particle Accelerator
7.text:
After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 damage from the impact location in different directions.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

7.name: Rift Shock
7.text: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105 damage over 3 seconds.

7.name: Tower Defense
7.text: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

10.name: Pylon Overcharge
10.text: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

10.name: Null Gate
10.text:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

13.name: Aggressive Matrix
13.text: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

13.name: Power Overflowing
13.text: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

13.name: Shield Battery
13.text: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 Shields per second, up to 112. Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

16.name: Quantum Entanglement
16.text: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

16.name: Gravity Well
16.text: Enemies are Slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

16.name: Interference
16.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

20.name: Construct Additional Pylons
20.text: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

20.name: Gate Keeper
20.text: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

20.name: Shoot 'Em Up
20.text:
Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

20.name: Probius Loop
20.text: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.
